tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen. Warm cream, never pure white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, inputs, the floating tab bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Track of progress bars and segmented controls, quiet fills inside cards.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and icons on ground and surface. Also the primary button fill in light theme.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: times, places, captions. 6.1:1 on ground (light), 9:1 on surface (dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers inside list groups; empty stepper steps.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Dark hero cards, the primary button, the raised mic button. Stays dark in both themes.

tokens.name: on-night
tokens.usage: Text on night.

tokens.name: lime
tokens.usage: THE brand colour. Net-worth hero, active tab pill, approve actions, Sikku the mascot. Text on lime is always ink #1d1b16.

tokens.name: lime-deep
tokens.usage: Positive money text (+₹, on pace) on ground or surface. 7.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Attention: the current stepper step, review badge, confetti. Never used for text; pair with ink text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive text only (Delete, Erase data). 6.5:1 on white.

tokens.name: on-pastel
tokens.usage: Main text on any category pastel, in both themes.

tokens.name: cat-dining-bg
tokens.usage: Dining tile, chip and hero fill (peach).

tokens.name: cat-dining-fg
tokens.usage: Dining icon and label on cat-dining-bg. 7.0:1.

tokens.name: cat-groceries-bg
tokens.usage: Groceries fill (soft lime).

tokens.name: cat-groceries-fg
tokens.usage: Groceries icon and label on its fill. 8.2:1.

tokens.name: cat-transport-bg
tokens.usage: Transport and bank accounts fill (sky).

tokens.name: cat-transport-fg
tokens.usage: Transport icon and label on its fill. 8.3:1.

tokens.name: cat-shopping-bg
tokens.usage: Shopping and credit cards fill (pink).

tokens.name: cat-shopping-fg
tokens.usage: Shopping icon and label on its fill. 7.6:1.

tokens.name: cat-fun-bg
tokens.usage: Fun, streaks, voice and assets hero fill (lilac).

tokens.name: cat-fun-fg
tokens.usage: Fun icon and label on its fill. 8.0:1.

tokens.name: cat-bills-bg
tokens.usage: Bills, investments, amount-entry hero fill (butter).

tokens.name: cat-bills-fg
tokens.usage: Bills icon and label on its fill. 7.8:1.

tokens.name: cat-health-bg
tokens.usage: Health and backup fill (mint).

tokens.name: cat-health-fg
tokens.usage: Health icon and label on its fill. 7.7:1.

styles.name: amount-xl
styles.usage: The one big number per screen: net worth, an amount being reviewed.

styles.name: amount-md
styles.usage: Amounts in rows, tiles and chips.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Sikka reads payment SMS and never leaves your phone.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Row titles, button text, toggle labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under a label. Use ink-muted.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase labels on heroes and group headers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gaps inside chips and between stepper bars.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips, tiles in a grid.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards on a screen; icon-to-text gap in rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Hero card padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Top padding of a screen; space above a primary button.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large separations, empty-state breathing room.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon tiles inside rows, small buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Category tiles, keypad keys, segmented options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups, transaction rows.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero cards, swipe-deck cards, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, toggles, the tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: White cards and rows sitting on ground.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar and the top card of the swipe deck.

tokens.name: shadow-ring
tokens.usage: Halo around the mic and approve buttons; animates outward when listening.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Press feedback, toggle knob.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Chips selecting, cards entering, sheet slide.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Hero numbers counting up, bars growing, stepper filling.

tokens.name: dur-celebrate
tokens.usage: Confetti and the success check. Only once per moment.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default: things arriving on screen.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Pops with a little overshoot: badges, the check, chips being picked.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Things leaving: a card flung off the deck.
